QuestInfo.name: Field Trip to Henesys
QuestInfo.0: There's a frightening rumor going around Henesys! Speak with Chief Stan to get to the bottom of it!
QuestInfo.1: There's a frightening rumor going around Henesys! Speak with Chief Stan to get to the bottom of it!
QuestInfo.2: Monster Kindergarten school buses were seen in the Six Path Crossway near Henesys. Chief Stan doesn't know what they're doing there, but he's worried they could cause havoc in Henesys.
